Hello,
Is it possible to check logs on chargers 170002555 and 170002651 of Frascati today 12/03 between 15:30 p.m. and 16:15 p.m. (CU Time)? A client was charging on charger 170002555 when the charging session suddenly interrupted. Then, the client attempted to charge on charger 170002651 without success.
Is it possible to check what happened, please?
Thank you in advance,

additional_info.subject: ID0484036-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002555] Check on logs CRM:02832000872
additional_info.body:
Dear Alba,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the provided information and detailed investigation of the data recorded between 15:30 and 16:15 CU time, we can confirm that the charging sessions you mentioned were terminated by the EV, rather than by a charger issue.
The logs of charger
170002555/oaxnbb
indicate that the EV ceased charging upon reaching its desired bulk charge level.
The logs of charger
170002651/
mn0YSA
shown that charging did not commence, a condition also attributable to the EV.
No errors were recorded on the charging stations side for the specified timestamp and charging sessions.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or concerns. If not, we will close the ticket within 48 hours.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
